articles.title: Teaching Teens to Code
articles.topic: 教青少年编程：为何越早接触计算机越好
articles.source: 2016 年考研英语（二）Text 1 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: It's true that high-school coding classes aren't essential for learning computer science in college.
sentences.cn: 诚然，高中编码课程对于大学计算机科学的学习并非必不可少。

sentences.en: Students without experience can catch up after a few introductory courses, said Tom Cortina, the assistant dean at Carnegie Mellon's School of Computer Science.
sentences.cn: 没有经验的学生在几节入门课程之后便可以赶上，卡内基梅隆大学计算机科学学院的副院长汤姆·科尔蒂纳说道。

sentences.en: However, Cortina said, early exposure is beneficial.
sentences.cn: 然而，科尔蒂纳说，早点接触（编码课程）是有益的。

sentences.en: When younger kids learn computer science, they learn that it's not just a confusing, endless string of letters and numbers - but a tool to build apps, or create artwork, or test hypotheses.
sentences.cn: 年龄较小的孩子学习计算机科学时，他们认识到它并非只是令人困惑的、无休止的字母与数字组成的字符串——也是构建应用程序、创造艺术作品、检验假设的工具。

words.meaning: 词组：令人困惑的、无休止的字符串

sentences.en: It's not as hard for them to transform their thought processes as it is for older students.
sentences.cn: 对于他们来说，转换思维过程不会像年龄较大的学生（转换思维过程）那样难。

words.meaning: 词组：转换他们的思维过程

sentences.en: Breaking down problems into bite-sized chunks and using code to solve them becomes normal.
sentences.cn: 把问题分解成小块然后使用编码解决问题变得稀松平常。

words.meaning: 词组：小块，易消化的小部分

sentences.en: Giving more children this training could increase the number of people interested in the field and help fill the jobs gap, Cortina said.
sentences.cn: 给予更多的孩子这样的培训会增加对这一领域感兴趣者的人数，从而有助于填补职位缺口，科尔蒂纳说道。

sentences.en: Students also benefit from learning something about coding before they get to college, where introductory computer-science classes are packed to the brim, which can drive the less-experienced or -determined students away.
sentences.cn: 学生在进入大学之前也会从学习一些有关编码的知识中获益，因为在大学里，计算机科学入门课程都排得满满当当，这可能会吓跑那些经验欠缺或意志力不足的学生。

words.meaning: 词组：满满当当，挤得满满的

words.w: drive the less-experienced or -determined students away
words.meaning: 词组：吓跑经验欠缺或意志力不足的学生

sentences.en: The Flatiron School, where people pay to learn programming, started as one of the many coding bootcamps that's become popular for adults looking for a career change.
sentences.cn: Flatiron 学校，人们花钱来学习编程的地方，创办之初只是众多编码训练营之中的一家，现如今已在那些寻求职业转变的成人中大受欢迎。

sentences.en: The high-schoolers get the same curriculum, but "we try to gear lessons toward things they're interested in," said Victoria Friedman, an instructor.
sentences.cn: 高中生上相同的课程，但是“我们在努力根据他们的兴趣来调整课程，”一位名叫维多利亚·弗里德曼的讲师说道。

sentences.en: For instance, one of the apps the students are developing suggests movies based on your mood.
sentences.cn: 例如，学生们正在开发的应用之一就是基于你的心情来推荐电影。

sentences.en: The students in the Flatiron class probably won't drop out of high school and build the next Facebook.
sentences.cn: Flatiron 课堂的学生很可能不会从高中辍学去创建下一个 Facebook。

sentences.en: Programming languages have a quick turnover, so the "Ruby on Rails" language they learned may not even be relevant by the time they enter the job market.
sentences.cn: 程序语言不断推陈出新，因此在他们进入就业市场时，所学的“Ruby on Rails”语言也许甚至已与当下完全脱节。

words.meaning: adj. 相关的，切合当下的

sentences.en: But the skills they learn - how to think logically through a problem and organize the results - apply to any coding language, said Deborah Seehorn, an education consultant for the state of North Carolina.
sentences.cn: 但是他们学到的技能——如何有逻辑地充分思考某问题并整理结果——适用于任何一种编码语言，南卡罗来纳州的一名教育顾问黛博拉·希霍恩说道。

words.meaning: 词组：适用于任何一种编码语言

sentences.en: Indeed, the Flatiron students might not go into IT at all.
sentences.cn: 实际上，Flatiron 学校的学生可能根本不会从事 IT 行业。

words.meaning: 词组：进入/从事 IT 行业

sentences.en: But creating a future army of coders is not the sole purpose of the classes.
sentences.cn: 但是创建一支未来程序员队伍并不是这些课程的唯一目的。

words.meaning: 词组：一支未来程序员大军

sentences.en: These kids are going to be surrounded by computers - in their pockets, in their offices, in their homes - for the rest of their lives.
sentences.cn: 这些孩子未来的岁月将会被电脑包围——口袋中有电脑、办公室有电脑、家里有电脑。

words.w: for the rest of their lives

sentences.en: The younger they learn how computers think, how to coax the machine into producing what they want - the earlier they learn that they have the power to do that - the better.
sentences.cn: 他们越早学习电脑如何思维，如何劝诱这一机器去制作自己需要的东西——他们越早了解到自己具备这种能力——对他们也越好。

words.meaning: 词组：劝诱机器去制作出

words.w: have the power to do that
words.meaning: 词组：具备做这件事的能力

questions.stem: Cortina holds that early exposure to computer science makes it easier to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 科尔蒂纳认为早点接触计算机科学会使___变得更容易。

options.B: remodel the way of thinking

options_cn.B: 重塑思维方式
options_cn.C: 构想逻辑假设
options_cn.D: 完善艺术制作

questions.explanation: 第二段指出，年龄较小的孩子学计算机时“转换思维过程不会像大龄学生那样难”，即年少时接触计算机比成年后更易改变思维方式，[B] remodel the way of thinking 是对 transform their thought processes 的同义改写，正确。[A] 利用 training、jobs gap 夸大为“完成工作培训”；[C][D] 分别偷换 test hypotheses、create artwork，且不符合“越早越容易”这一信息。

questions.stem: In delivering lessons for high-schoolers, Flatiron has considered their ___.
questions.stem_cn: 在为高中生上课时，Flatiron 学校考虑到了他们的___。

options.B: interest

options_cn.B: 兴趣
options_cn.C: 职业前景
options_cn.D: 学术背景

questions.explanation: 第四段指出高中生上同样的课程，而 Flatiron 的不同之处在于“努力根据学生的兴趣来调整课程（gear lessons toward things they're interested in）”，可见“兴趣”是其考虑的因素，[B] 正确。[A][C] 利用“该校受寻求职业转变的成年人欢迎”臆测，与题干所问的“高中生”无关；[D] 为捕风捉影的捏造。

questions.stem: Deborah Seehorn believes that the skills learned at Flatiron will ___.
questions.stem_cn: 黛博拉·希霍恩认为在 Flatiron 学校学到的技能会___。

options.A: help students learn other computer languages
options.B: have to be upgraded when new technologies come
options.C: need improving when students look for jobs
options.D: enable students to make big quick money

options_cn.A: 有助于学生掌握其他计算机语言
options_cn.B: 在新科技到来时不得不进行改进
options_cn.C: 在学生找工作时需要提高
options_cn.D: 使学生能够快速地赚大钱

questions.explanation: 第五段指出，虽然所学编程语言更新换代很快，但学到的技能（逻辑性、条理性）“适用于任何一种编码语言（apply to any coding language）”，即有助于学生掌握其他计算机语言，[A] 正确。[B][C] 利用“当前所学语言未必适用于未来”过度推断为“技能须改进/提高”；[D] 利用 turnover 曲解词义、凭空捏造。

questions.stem: According to the last paragraph, Flatiron students are expected to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据最后一段可知，Flatiron 学校的学生预计会___。

options.B: stay longer in the information technology industry
options.C: become better prepared for the digitalized world
options.D: compete with a future army of programmers

options_cn.A: 带来创新的计算机技术
options_cn.B: 在 IT 行业从业较长时间
options_cn.C: 为数字化的世界做好更充分的准备
options_cn.D: 与未来的程序员大军竞争

questions.explanation: 末段指出培养编码大军并非课程唯一目的，随后说明：计算机将持续包围人们的生活，越早了解计算机、让其为我所用就越好，即 Flatiron 还致力于“使人更好应对数字时代”，[C] 正确。[A] 过度推出“带来创新技术”；[B] 与“可能根本不从事 IT”反向矛盾；[D] 利用 a future army of coders 编造。

questions.stem: The word "coax" (Line 4, Para. 6) is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 与“coax”（第六段第四行）含义最接近的是___。

options.B: frighten

options_cn.B: 吓唬
options_cn.C: 误导
options_cn.D: 挑战

questions.explanation: 由第六段末句语境可知，让青少年学计算机的目的是利用计算机处理实际问题，即用编码语言“与机器对话、向其发出命令”以开发应用满足生活需求，coax the machine into producing 即“劝诱机器制作出所需之物”，故 [A] persuade 符合，正确。[B] frighten...into 表“把……吓得做某事”，感情色彩相悖；[C][D] 从形式与内容上均不符。

articles.title: Saving the Lesser Prairie Chicken
articles.topic: 拯救小草原松鸡：受威胁标签背后的合作与争议
articles.source: 2016 年考研英语（二）Text 2 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Biologists estimate that as many as 2 million lesser prairie chickens - a kind of bird living on stretching grasslands - once lent red to the often grey landscape of the midwestern and southwestern United States.
sentences.cn: 生物学家估计，多达200万只的小草原松鸡——一种栖息于绵延草地的鸟类——曾为美国中西部和西南部常年灰暗的风景增添了一抹红色。

sentences.en: But just some 22,000 birds remain today, occupying about 16% of the species' historic range.
sentences.cn: 但如今仅剩下约2.2万只，栖息地约为该物种历史分布范围的16%。

words.meaning: 词组：该物种的历史分布范围

sentences.en: The crash was a major reason the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) decided to formally list the bird as threatened.
sentences.cn: 这种急剧下降是美国鱼类及野生动物管理局（USFWS）决定正式将该鸟类列为受威胁物种的一个主要原因。

words.meaning: 词组：将该鸟列为受威胁物种

sentences.en: "The lesser prairie chicken is in a desperate situation," said USFWS Director Daniel Ashe.
sentences.cn: “小草原松鸡处于危急状态，”USFWS 局长丹尼尔·阿什说道。

sentences.en: Some environmentalists, however, were disappointed.
sentences.cn: 然而一些环保主义者对此决定感到失望。

sentences.en: They had pushed the agency to designate the bird as "endangered," a status that gives federal officials greater regulatory power to crack down on threats.
sentences.cn: 他们曾敦促该机构将这一鸟类认定为“濒危物种”，这一定位会给予联邦官员更大的监管权力，以打击对该物种的威胁。

sentences.en: But Ashe and others argued that the "threatened" tag gave the federal government flexibility to try out new, potentially less confrontational conservation approaches.
sentences.cn: 但是阿什及其他人士坚称，“受威胁物种”标签给了联邦政府尝试新的、潜在对抗性较低的保护方法的灵活性。

sentences.en: In particular, they called for forging closer collaborations with western state governments, which are often uneasy with federal action, and with the private landowners who control an estimated 95% of the prairie chicken's habitat.
sentences.cn: 特别是，他们呼吁与西部各州政府（通常不满联邦政府的行动）以及私人土地所有者（控制着约95%的草原松鸡栖息地）缔造更紧密的合作关系。

words.meaning: 词组：缔造更紧密的合作

sentences.en: Under the plan, for example, the agency said it would not prosecute landowners or businesses that unintentionally kill, harm, or disturb the bird, as long as they had signed a range-wide management plan to restore prairie chicken habitat.
sentences.cn: 在此项计划之下，例如，该机构表示它不会起诉非故意杀死、伤害或骚扰该鸟类的土地所有者或企业，只要他们已经签署一项为恢复草原松鸡栖息地而制定的大范围管理计划。

sentences.en: Negotiated by USFWS and the states, the plan requires individuals and businesses that damage habitat as part of their operations to pay into a fund to replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres of suitable habitat.
sentences.cn: 经 USFWS 与各州协商决定，这一计划要求在经营中破坏栖息地的个人和企业向一项基金付款，用两英亩适宜的新栖息地来替代每一英亩被破坏的栖息地。

sentences.en: The fund will also be used to compensate landowners who set aside habitat.
sentences.cn: 该基金还将被用于补偿保留栖息地的土地所有者。

sentences.en: USFWS also set an interim goal of restoring prairie chicken populations to an annual average of 67,000 birds over the next 10 years.
sentences.cn: USFWS 还设定了一个暂时性目标：在未来十年将草原松鸡的数量恢复到平均每年6.7万只。

words.meaning: 词组：一个阶段性/暂时性目标

sentences.en: And it gives the Western Association of Fish and Wildlife Agencies (WAFWA), a coalition of state agencies, the job of monitoring progress.
sentences.cn: 且它将监督进程的职责赋予了州级机构联盟“鱼类及野生动物管理局西部联合会（WAFWA）”。

sentences.en: Overall, the idea is to let "states remain in the driver's seat for managing the species," Ashe said.
sentences.cn: 总的说来，其理念是让“各州处于管理该物种的主导地位，”阿什说道。

words.meaning: 词组：处于主导/掌控地位

sentences.en: Not everyone buys the win-win rhetoric.
sentences.cn: 不是每个人都接受这种双赢说辞。

words.meaning: v. 接受，相信（此处引申义）

sentences.en: Some Congress members are trying to block the plan, and at least a dozen industry groups, four states, and three environmental groups are challenging it in federal court.
sentences.cn: 一些国会议员正试图阻挠该计划的实施，且至少有十几个行业团体、四个州以及三个环境保护组织正在联邦法庭上对其发起质疑。

words.meaning: 词组：在联邦法庭上对其发起质疑

sentences.en: Not surprisingly, industry groups and states generally argue it goes too far; environmentalists say it doesn't go far enough.
sentences.cn: 行业团体和各州普遍认为它做得太过，而环保主义者表示它做得还不够，这并不令人意外。

words.meaning: 词组：不出所料，并不令人意外

sentences.en: "The federal government is giving responsibility for managing the bird to the same industries that are pushing it to extinction," says biologist Jay Lininger.
sentences.cn: “联邦政府正将对该鸟类的管理责任交给恰恰是正在将其推向灭绝的行业，”生物学家杰伊·林恩格说道。

questions.stem: The major reason for listing the lesser prairie chicken as threatened is ___.
questions.stem_cn: 将小草原松鸡列为受威胁物种的主要原因是___。

options.B: the underestimate of the grassland acreage
options.C: a desperate appeal from some biologists

options_cn.B: 草原面积被低估
options_cn.C: 一些生物学家的迫切呼吁
options_cn.D: 私有土地所有者的坚持

questions.explanation: 第二段①句指出“这种急剧下降（The crash）”是列为受威胁物种的主要原因，而 The crash 回指第一段“小草原松鸡数量及栖息地的锐减”，故 [A] its drastically decreased population 正确。[B] 将“栖息地面积缩减”篡改为“草原面积被低估”；[C] 把“环保人士呼吁列为濒危”偷换为“生物学家呼吁”；[D] 因果倒置。

questions.stem: The "threatened" tag disappointed some environmentalists in that it ___.
questions.stem_cn: “受威胁”标签令一些环保主义者感到失望，是因为它___。

options.A: was a give-in to governmental pressure
options.B: would involve fewer agencies in action

options_cn.A: 是对政府压力的一种屈服
options_cn.B: 会使参与行动的机构变少
options_cn.C: 赋予了较小的联邦监管权
options_cn.D: 与保护政策相违背

questions.explanation: 第二段③④句指出：一些环保主义者失望，因为他们曾敦促将该鸟列为“濒危”——那一身份能给联邦官员更大的监管权力；反过来说“受威胁”标签意味着联邦监管权力较小，故 [C] 正确。[A] 误把 They 理解为“政府”；[B] 与原文推断完全相反；[D] 对 confrontational conservation approaches 断章取义。

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that unintentional harm-doers will not be prosecuted if they ___.
questions.stem_cn: 从第三段可知，非故意伤害者将不会被起诉，如果他们___。

options.A: agree to pay a sum for compensation
options.B: volunteer to set up an equally big habitat
options.C: offer to support the WAFWA monitoring job
options.D: promise to raise funds for USFWS operations

options_cn.B: 自愿建立一个同样大小的栖息地
options_cn.C: 愿意支持 WAFWA 的监督工作
options_cn.D: 承诺为 USFWS 的运作筹集资金

questions.explanation: 第三段前两句指出：非故意伤害者不被起诉的条件是签署恢复栖息地的管理计划，而该计划要求破坏栖息地者向保护基金付款（用2倍土地替代被破坏栖息地）。综合可知条件是向基金支付补偿金，[A] 正确。[B] 中 equally big 属捏造；[C] 强加关联；[D] 将“个人企业的运作”“保护基金”杂糅捏造。

questions.stem: According to Ashe, the leading role in managing the species is ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据阿什所说，在管理该物种中扮演主导角色的是___。

options.B: the wildlife agencies

options_cn.B: 野生动物机构
options_cn.C: 土地所有者
options_cn.D: 各州

questions.explanation: 第三段末句总结：其基本理念是让“各州处于管理该物种的主导地位（states remain in the driver's seat）”，故 [D] 正确。[A] 将“给联邦政府更多灵活性”曲解为“让其主导”；[B] 把“负责监督进程”错误等同于“主导管理”，且负责监督的是 WAFWA；[C] 由“控制大部分栖息地”过度推断。

questions.stem: Jay Lininger would most likely support ___.
questions.stem_cn: 杰伊·林恩格最可能支持___。

options.B: the win-win rhetoric

options_cn.B: 双赢说辞
options_cn.C: 环保团体
options_cn.D: 受到挑战的计划

questions.explanation: 末段引 Jay Lininger 的话：联邦政府是在把管理责任推给正在将该物种推向灭绝的行业，可见他认为联邦政府应自己承担主要责任，而不应交给各州和各行业，这与环保主义者观点一致，故 [C] 正确。[A] 与其批评各行业的态度相悖；[B][D] 均与其质疑该方案的立场矛盾。

articles.title: Finding Time to Read
articles.topic: 如何找时间阅读：效率思维为何是深度阅读之敌
articles.source: 2016 年考研英语（二）Text 3 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: That everyone's too busy these days is a cliche.
sentences.cn: 现在人人都太忙，这是老生常谈。

words.meaning: 词组：陈词滥调，老生常谈

sentences.en: But one specific complaint is made especially mournfully: There's never any time to read.
sentences.cn: 但是，一个具体而又极其悲哀的抱怨是：根本没时间阅读。

sentences.en: What makes the problem thornier is that the usual time-management techniques don't seem sufficient.
sentences.cn: 使这一问题更加棘手的是，那些常规的时间管理技巧似乎并不奏效。

words.meaning: adj. 更棘手的（thorny 比较级）

sentences.en: The web's full of articles offering tips on making time to read: "Give up TV" or "Carry a book with you at all times."
sentences.cn: 网上有很多介绍“腾出时间阅读”小窍门的文章，比如“不看电视”、“身边随时带一本书”。

sentences.en: But in my experience, using such methods to free up the odd 30 minutes doesn't work.
sentences.cn: 但根据我的经验，采用这些窍门挤出个30来分钟并没什么用。

sentences.en: Sit down to read and the flywheel of work-related thoughts keeps spinning - or else you're so exhausted that a challenging book's the last thing you need.
sentences.cn: 坐下来认真阅读却发现与工作相关的思绪飞轮始终转个不停——要不就是极度疲惫，以至于阅读一本有挑战的书成为你最不想去做的事。

words.meaning: 词组：与工作相关的思绪飞轮

sentences.en: The modern mind, Tim Parks, a novelist and critic, writes, "is overwhelmingly inclined toward communication... It is not simply that one is interrupted; it is that one is actually inclined to interruption."
sentences.cn: 小说家兼评论家蒂姆·帕克斯写道：现代人的大脑“非常愿意交流……不是被打断这么简单，而是人们真的愿意中断。”

words.meaning: 词组：现代人的头脑/心智

sentences.en: Deep reading requires not just time, but a special kind of time which can't be obtained merely by becoming more efficient.
sentences.cn: 深度阅读需要的不只是时间，而是一种特殊的时间，这种时间仅仅靠提高效率是无法得到的。

sentences.en: In fact, "becoming more efficient" is part of the problem.
sentences.cn: 事实上，“变得更加高效”是问题的一部分。

sentences.en: Thinking of time as a resource to be maximised means you approach it instrumentally, judging any given moment as well spent only in so far as it advances progress toward some goal.
sentences.cn: 把时间看作一种要最大限度利用的资源意味着你功利性地对待时间：认为每一刻都应该充分利用起来以使其向着某一既定目标迈进。

words.meaning: 词组：一种要最大化利用的资源
词组：功利性地/工具性地对待它

sentences.en: Immersive reading, by contrast, depends on being willing to risk inefficiency, goallessness, even time-wasting.
sentences.cn: 相形之下，沉浸式阅读需要人们愿意承担低效率、无目标、甚至浪费时间的风险。

sentences.en: Try to slot it in as a to-do list item and you'll manage only goal-focused reading - useful, sometimes, but not the most fulfilling kind.
sentences.cn: 试图把它塞进任务清单里只能进行目标集中式阅读——有时候有用，但并非最令人满足的阅读方式。

words.meaning: 词组：任务清单上的一项

sentences.en: "The future comes at us like empty bottles along an unstoppable and nearly infinite conveyor belt," writes Gary Eberle in his book Sacred Time, and "we feel a pressure to fill these different-sized bottles (days, hours, minutes) as they pass, for if they get by without being filled, we will have wasted them."
sentences.cn: “未来就像永不停歇、永无止境传送带上的空瓶子一样向我们走来”，盖里·埃伯利在他《神圣的时间》一书中写道：“随着时间的流逝，我们要把这些不同大小的瓶子（天，小时，分钟）装满，对此我们倍感压力，因为如果它们没有被装满就过去了，我们就是浪费了它们。”

words.meaning: 词组：感到有把……装满的压力

sentences.en: No mind-set could be worse for losing yourself in a book.
sentences.cn: 没有什么思维模式比这种思维模式更不利于沉浸在书本中了。

sentences.en: So what does work? Perhaps surprisingly, scheduling regular times for reading.
sentences.cn: 那什么才起作用呢？安排固定时间阅读，这也许出人意料。

sentences.en: You'd think this might fuel the efficiency mind-set, but in fact, Eberle notes, such ritualistic behaviour helps us "step outside time's flow" into "soul time."
sentences.cn: 你或许认为这可能会加剧“效率至上”的思维倾向，但实际上，埃伯利指出，这种例行行为帮助我们“从时间的流逝中走出来”，进入“灵魂时间”。

words.meaning: 词组：助长效率至上的思维
词组：例行/仪式化的行为
词组：从时间的流逝中走出来

sentences.en: You could limit distractions by reading only physical books, or on single-purpose e-readers.
sentences.cn: 你可以通过只阅读纸质书或在只有单一功能的电子阅读器上阅读来减少干扰。

words.meaning: 词组：单一功能的电子阅读器

sentences.en: "Carry a book with you at all times" can actually work, too - providing you dip in often enough, so that reading becomes the default state from which you temporarily surface to take care of business, before dropping back down.
sentences.cn: “随时随身携带一本书”其实也可行——如果你能够频繁地沉入其中，这样阅读就成了你的默认状态，从中你可以暂时脱离开来处理工作，然后再沉浸进去。

words.meaning: 词组：随时翻阅，短暂投入

sentences.en: On a really good day, it no longer feels as if you're "making time to read," but just reading, and making time for everything else.
sentences.cn: 在一个着实美好的日子里，你不会再感觉像是在“挤时间阅读”，而是仅仅在阅读，并且是要挤时间去做其他事。

words.meaning: 词组：在真正美好的一天
词组：为其他一切事情挤出时间

questions.stem: The usual time-management techniques don't work because ___.
questions.stem_cn: 常规的时间管理技巧不起作用的原因是___。

options.A: what they can offer does not ease the modern mind
options.B: what challenging books demand is repetitive reading
options.C: what people often forget is carrying a book with them
options.D: what deep reading requires cannot be guaranteed

options_cn.A: 它们所提供的东西不能使现代人放松
options_cn.B: 具有挑战性的书需要的是反复阅读
options_cn.C: 人们经常忘记的是随身携带一本书
options_cn.D: 深度阅读所需要的无法得到保证

questions.explanation: 第二段指出常规时间管理技巧不可行，末句总结根本原因：深度阅读需要的不只是普通时间，而是一种“仅凭提高效率无法获得的特殊时间”，故 [D] cannot be guaranteed 是对末句的合理概括，正确。[A] 在“技巧不能让人放松”与“技巧不管用”间强加因果；[B][C] 分别对 challenging book、Carry a book 断章取义。

questions.stem: The "empty bottles" metaphor illustrates that people feel a pressure to ___.
questions.stem_cn: “空瓶子”的隐喻表明人们感到有压力去___。

options.B: make passing time fulfilling

options_cn.B: 让流逝的时间充实起来
options_cn.C: 完成他们的计划
options_cn.D: 追求无忧无虑的阅读

questions.explanation: 第三段的“空瓶子”隐喻把“未来”比作沿传送带不断运来的空瓶子，说明人们迫切地想把这些象征“时间”的瓶子装满，否则就是虚度光阴，即人们因“想把流逝的时间安排得充实”而备受压力，故 [B] make passing time fulfilling 与原文 fill these different-sized bottles as they pass 相对应，正确。[A][C][D] 均为杂糅细节或无关捏造。

questions.stem: Eberle would agree that scheduling regular times for reading helps ___.
questions.stem_cn: 埃伯利赞同安排固定时间段阅读有助于___。

options.B: develop online reading habits

options_cn.A: 激励效率至上的思维模式
options_cn.B: 培养在线阅读的习惯
options_cn.C: 促进例行性阅读
options_cn.D: 实现沉浸式阅读

questions.explanation: 第四段借 Eberle 观点说明“固定时间阅读”的作用：帮助人们挣脱“时间的流逝”，进入“灵魂时间”，联系上文即不再为浪费时间而惶恐、实现纯粹的沉浸式阅读，故 [D] achieve immersive reading 正确。[A] 出自“让步”逻辑的惯常看法；[B] 对“只读纸质书”断章取义；[C] 是常识推断，并非文中 Eberle 的观点。

questions.stem: "Carry a book with you at all times" can work if ___.
questions.stem_cn: “始终随身携带一本书”会起作用，如果___。

options.A: reading becomes your primary business of the day
options.B: all the daily business has been promptly dealt with
options.C: you are able to drop back to business after reading
options.D: time can be evenly split for reading and business

options_cn.A: 阅读成为你一天当中的首要事务
options_cn.B: 所有的日常事务都已得到立即处理
options_cn.C: 你能够在阅读之后返回到工作中去
options_cn.D: 时间可以平均分配给阅读和工作

questions.explanation: 第四段末尾指出“随身携带一本书”起作用的条件（providing 意为“如果”）：能经常沉浸书中、阅读成为默认状态，其他事务变为附带，即阅读成为高于其他事务的首要事务，故 [A] 正确。[B] 把“短暂浮出处理事务”偷换为“所有事务立即处理”；[C] 颠倒关系；[D] 与“阅读为主”矛盾。

questions.stem: The best title for this text could be ___.
questions.stem_cn: 本文最佳标题可能是___。

options.B: How to Find Time to Read

options_cn.B: 如何找时间阅读
options_cn.C: 如何设定阅读目标
options_cn.D: 如何广泛阅读

questions.explanation: 全文首段提出“人们总抱怨没时间阅读”，二三段分析常见时间管理技巧不可行的根本原因，末段提出建议：安排固定时间、把阅读当“主业”，可见全文围绕“如何找时间阅读”给出可行办法，故 [B] 正确。标题须涵盖“阅读、时间”两个关键信息，[A][C][D] 均遗漏“时间”，且 enjoy、reading goals、extensively 为捕风捉影。

articles.title: A New Road Map to Success
articles.topic: 年轻美国人的成功路线图：同一终点，不同路径
articles.source: 2016 年考研英语（二）Text 4 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Against a backdrop of drastic changes in economy and population structure, younger Americans are drawing a new 21st-century road map to success, a latest poll has found.
sentences.cn: 最新民意调查发现：在经济、人口结构急剧改变的背景下，较为年轻的美国人正在绘制一幅新型的21世纪成功路线图。

sentences.en: Across generational lines, Americans continue to prize many of the same traditional milestones of a successful life, including getting married, having children, owning a home, and retiring in their sixties.
sentences.cn: 跨越代际线，美国人依然高度重视许多相同的、传统的成功人生标志性事件，包括结婚、生子、购房及六十多岁退休。

words.meaning: 词组：跨越代际（不分老少）

sentences.en: But while young and old mostly agree on what constitutes the finish line of a fulfilling life, they offer strikingly different paths for reaching it.
sentences.cn: 但是，尽管年轻一辈和老一辈在“什么构成成功人生的终点线”上大体达成共识，他们却提供了截然不同的到达终点线的路径。

sentences.en: Young people who are still getting started in life were more likely than older adults to prioritize personal fulfillment in their work, to believe they will advance their careers most by regularly changing jobs, to favor communities with more public services and a faster pace of life, to agree that couples should be financially secure before getting married or having children, and to maintain that children are best served by two parents working outside the home, the survey found.
sentences.cn: 调查发现：相比稍微年长一些的成年人来讲，仍处于人生起步阶段的年轻人更可能在工作中优先考虑个人成就感，他们觉得频繁更换工作最能推动职业发展，他们更喜欢公共服务更多、生活节奏更快的社区，他们赞同夫妻在结婚生子前应该有经济保障，并认为孩子最好由均在外工作的双亲来抚育。

words.meaning: 词组：优先考虑个人成就感

sentences.en: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.
sentences.cn: 从职业发展到社区、家庭，这些差异表明：在灼热的大衰退余波下，那些人生刚刚起步的人正在界定首要事项和期望，这些事项和期望将逐渐蔓延到美国人生活的几乎所有方面，从消费者偏好到居住模式，再到政治。

words.meaning: 词组：蔓延至几乎所有方面

sentences.en: Young and old converge on one key point: Overwhelming majorities of both groups said they believe it is harder for young people today to get started in life than it was for earlier generations.
sentences.cn: 年轻一辈和老一辈在一个关键点上观点趋向：双方以压倒性多数认为当今年轻人比前几代人更难起步。

words.meaning: 词组：（在某点上）趋于一致

sentences.en: While younger people are somewhat more optimistic than their elders about the prospects for those starting out today, big majorities in both groups believe those "just getting started in life" face a tougher climb than earlier generations in reaching such signpost achievements as securing a good-paying job, starting a family, managing debt, and finding affordable housing.
sentences.cn: 尽管年轻人要比年长者对今天刚起步的年轻人的前景多少乐观一点，但是双方绝大多数认为，在实现诸如获取高薪的工作、组建家庭、债务管理、拥有买得起的住房这些标志性成就上，那些“刚起步”的人比前几代人面临更艰难的攀行。

words.meaning: 词组：面临更艰难的攀爬

sentences.en: Pete Schneider considers the climb tougher today.
sentences.cn: 皮特·施耐德认为现如今的攀行更艰难。

sentences.en: Schneider, a 27-year-old auto technician from the Chicago suburbs, says he struggled to find a job after graduating from college.
sentences.cn: 施耐德，一位来自芝加哥郊区的27岁汽车技师，说大学毕业后很努力才找到一份工作。

sentences.en: Even now that he is working steadily, he said, "I can't afford to pay my monthly mortgage payments on my own, so I have to rent rooms out to people to make that happen."
sentences.cn: 尽管工作稳定，但是“凭一己之力无法负担月供，因此不得不把房间租给别人以负担月供，”他说。

sentences.en: Looking back, he is struck that his parents could provide a comfortable life for their children even though neither had completed college when he was young.
sentences.cn: 回首过往，他猛然发现，小时候父母尽管都没有读大学，却也能为孩子们提供一个舒适的生活。

sentences.en: "I still grew up in an upper middle-class home with parents who didn't have college degrees," Schneider said. "I don't think people are capable of that anymore."
sentences.cn: “尽管爸妈没有大学文凭，但是我仍然在一个上层中产阶级家庭中长大，”施耐德说，“我想人们再也做不到那样了。”

words.meaning: 词组：一个上层中产阶级家庭

questions.stem: One cross-generation mark of a successful life is ___.
questions.stem_cn: 成功人生的一个跨世代标志是___。

options.B: having a family with children

options_cn.B: 结婚生子
options_cn.C: 到退休年龄后仍旧工作
options_cn.D: 创建一家盈利企业

questions.explanation: 第二段①句指出，跨越代际线，美国人依旧重视成功人生的传统里程碑，如结婚生子、拥有住房及六十来岁退休，[B] having a family with children 是对 getting married, having children 的同义改写，正确。[A] 曲解 strikingly different paths；[C] 把“六十几岁退休”反向曲解为“退休年龄后仍工作”；[D] 曲解 financially secure。

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that young people tend to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 从第三段可以得知年轻人往往___。

options.B: hold an occupation longer
options.D: give priority to childcare outside the home

options_cn.A: 更喜欢较慢的生活节奏
options_cn.B: 在一个职位上待得更久
options_cn.C: 重视婚前财务状况
options_cn.D: 优先考虑在外面托管孩子

questions.explanation: 第三段从职业、社区、家庭角度指出年轻人的取向，其中“赞同夫妻在结婚或生子前应有经济保障”表明年轻人重视婚前财务状况，故 [C] 正确。[A] 把 a faster pace of life 反向偷换为“更慢”；[B] 把 regularly changing jobs 反向曲解；[D] 把“孩子最好由均在外工作的双亲抚育”曲解为“在外托管孩子”。

questions.stem: The priorities and expectations defined by the young will ___.
questions.stem_cn: 年轻人界定的首要事项和期望将___。

options.B: focus on materialistic issues
options.D: reach almost all aspects of American life

options_cn.B: 聚焦物质问题
options_cn.C: 很大程度上取决于政治偏好
options_cn.D: 几乎触及美国人生活的所有方面

questions.explanation: 第四段指出，处于人生起步阶段的年轻人正在界定首要事项及期望，它们将逐渐蔓延至美国人生活的方方面面，[D] 是对 spread through virtually all aspects of American life 的同义替换，正确。[A] 把 defining、increasingly 杂糅捏造出“日益清晰”；[B][C] 分别借 consumer preferences、politics 等例证词曲解为“聚焦物质”“取决于政治偏好”。

questions.stem: Both young and old agree that ___.
questions.stem_cn: 年轻人和老一辈人都认为___。

options.B: the old made more life achievements
options.C: housing loans today are easy to obtain
options.D: getting established is harder for the young

options_cn.B: 老一辈人的人生成就更多
options_cn.C: 今天的住房贷款容易获得
options_cn.D: 对年轻人来说立足更困难

questions.explanation: 第五段指出两代人的共识：当今年轻人比前几代人更难起步，且在获取高薪工作、组建家庭、管理债务、拥有可支付住房等标志性成就上更为艰难，即年轻人立足更难，故 [D] getting established is harder for the young 正确。[A] 把“更难找到”曲解为“数量更少”；[B] 臆断两代人成就多少的比较；[C] 由 affordable housing 捏造“住房贷款更易获得”。

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about Schneider?
questions.stem_cn: 下面哪一项关于施耐德的内容是正确的？

options.A: He found a dream job after graduating from college.
options.B: His parents believe working steadily is a must for success.
options.C: His parents' good life has little to do with a college degree.
options.D: He thinks his job as a technician quite challenging.

options_cn.A: 他在大学毕业后找到了一份理想的工作。
options_cn.B: 他父母认为稳定工作是成功必需。
options_cn.C: 他父母的上乘生活和大学文凭几乎没有关系。
options_cn.D: 他认为他的技师工作颇有挑战性。

questions.explanation: 第六段指出，施耐德的父母虽然都没上过大学，却给孩子提供了舒适生活，他本人也在没有大学文凭的父母抚养下在上层中产阶级家庭长大，由此可推知“他父母的上乘生活与大学文凭几乎无关”，故 [C] 正确。[A] 与“毕业后艰难找工作”相反；[B][D] 均为文中未提及的捏造。
